title: Rav Achdevoi bar Avin

paragraphs: He said in the name of Rav, as cited in Yuchasin. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=360&lang=en) says, “I have not found it.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim gives this reading at [Avodah Zarah 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.34b.13). The Gemara texts Hyman uses say only, “Rav Achdevoi said in the name of Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Achdevoi transmitting Rav’s ruling without bar Avin. Heilprin lists Achadvoya bar Avin transmitting Rav but says he did not find mention of the name and that She’erit Yosef did not list him either.
